info.name: LedgerFlow API
info.description: Every endpoint of the LedgerFlow API (SRS section 10), for the manual verification checklist (section 19). Pick an environment (local or production), then run Login or Demo login and Users → Me: they save {{accessToken}} and {{orgId}} for the rest. Stripe webhooks are not here: they need Stripe's signature, so test them with `npm run stripe:listen` and `stripe trigger`.

request.description: Creates the user, organization, owner membership and Free subscription, and sends a verification email. No session until the email is verified (FR-AUTH-12).
Token from the link in the verification email (Mailtrap locally). Starts a session.
Same answer for every email. 3 per 15 minutes per IP.
Saves the access token; the refresh cookie goes to the Postman cookie jar. 5 per minute per IP.
Rotates the refresh cookie. 204 = no cookie sent; 401 = invalid, expired or reused (a reused one revokes the whole session). ?include=me also returns the account.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const d = pm.response.json().data; if (d && d.accessToken) pm.collectionVariables.set('accessToken', d.accessToken); }

request.description: Same answer for every email.
Token from the reset email. Signs out every session.
Empty unless DEMO_ENABLED=true on the API.
Accounts: acme-owner, acme-billing, globex-owner, initech-owner. Demo organizations refuse invitations, member changes and renaming (403 DEMO_RESTRICTED).
Saves the first organization as {{orgId}}.
Signs out every session, including this one.
Another organization answers 404 ORG_NOT_FOUND, never 403 (FR-ORG-02).
409 LAST_OWNER when demoting the last owner.
403 PLAN_LIMIT_SEATS when the seats are full.
Token from the invitation email.
Logged in as the invited email (403 INVITE_EMAIL_MISMATCH otherwise).
Open data.url and pay with 4242 4242 4242 4242. 409 ALREADY_SUBSCRIBED on a paid plan.
Saves {{prorationDate}} so the change charges exactly the previewed amount.

202: applied when the webhook arrives. A repeated Idempotency-Key returns the first result; the same key with another plan → 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. Run the preview first: it fills {{prorationDate}}.
The full key is returned only here; saved as {{apiKey}}.
Revoked keys get 401 INVALID_API_KEY on the very next request.
202 with periodUnits/includedUnits. 429 PLAN_LIMIT_USAGE at the Free limit, 429 RATE_LIMITED above 100 requests per second per key.
Same idempotencyKey: 202 with the original eventId and duplicate: true; nothing is counted twice.
Optional from/to (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 90 days); default the last 30 days.
Owners and admins. Optional category: members, api_keys, billing, usage, organization.
